ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
General Updates — Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange about Incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary
Capacity addition — Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition at Pipavav by Aegis Terminal (Pipavav) Limited (ATPL), subsidiary company.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — AEGIS LOGISTICS LIMITED has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — VOPAK INDIA B.V. has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
General Updates — Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange about the re-appointment of M/s. Natwarlal Vyapari & Co. LLP as the Internal Auditors for the financial year 2026-27.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.

Allotment of Securities — Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 1,03,000 securities pursuant to Non Convertible Securities at its meeting held on January 05, 2026
Issue of Securities — Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange about issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures ( NCDs ), for an amount upto Rs. 1030,00,00,000 on a Private Placement basis
